sources.snippet: Introducing S1-mini For the first time, Superwhisper is releasing a model with open weights. S1-mini is a .6B-parameter language model that processes transcripts entirely on your device. Try it in the app today or check it out on Hugging Face.

sources.snippet: The Voice AI startup Superwhisper announced the release of its S1 family of models on August 19, 2026, introducing cloud models "S1-Voice" and "S1-Language," alongside the on-device "S1-mini" model.
